key_phrases: active installed base of 1.8 billion devices
Apple silicon is blowing them away
analysis.reasoning: The company reported an all-time revenue record of $123.9B, driven by strong iPhone and Services performance. Sentiment is highly positive due to record-breaking metrics across almost all categories. However, forward guidance is cautious (tone 0.3) because management explicitly warned of revenue deceleration in the upcoming March quarter due to difficult year-over_year comparisons and foreign exchange headwinds. Supply chain constraints (specifically legacy nodes) remain a noted risk, though they are expected to ease slightly. Management showed high confidence in long-term ecosystem strength but was evasive regarding specific product roadmaps and exact subscriber numbers for Apple TV+.
